series.definition: A series is one artifact under one instrument: its rows that carry a count, restarted at each row flagged rebaseline: true.

rolling_origin.definition: For every row of a series with at least min_training_rows rows before it: forecast it from the rows before it only, one run ahead; error = actual - forecast.

methods.mean: the mean of every value so far
methods.drift: the last value plus the average change per run so far: (last - first) / (rows - 1)

scaled_error.definition: scaled error = |error| / scale, where scale is the mean absolute change between consecutive rows of the training rows (rows 1 to the origin)

leak_scale_computed_on_the_whole_series.note: Leaky variant: the scale is computed once on every row of the series, target rows included; the scaled error is then defined for every forecast of a series that varies.

leakage.kind: computed on the series that vary; the series that never vary add zero error under every test
leakage.definition: A backtest leaks when the forecast scored for a target row was computed from anything not yet recorded at its origin: the target, a later row, or a number derived from them.

leak_2_feature_that_encodes_the_target.forecast: previous count + delta_citations of the target row

on_all_pairs_of_consecutive_rows.note: No restart at rebaseline rows: the feature fails exactly where the feeder wrote 0.

leak_1_under_the_rolling_origin.note: Same targets as rolling_origin: the mean so far against the mean of the whole series.

cut_sweep.note: MAE of the fitted level on the test rows, rounded to 6 decimals; changes in percent

coin_flip_illustration.note: Chance that one method beats another on every comparison if each were a fair coin flip.

extrapolation.kind: computed under a stated assumption, not a forecast
extrapolation.assumption: Runs in which at least one count changes keep occurring at the frequency observed between rebaselined runs. One observed change run does not support this assumption; it only sets a scale.

whole_record_contrast.kind: computed; a contrast, not the module's main test
whole_record_contrast.note: One series per artifact, rebaseline rows kept as targets: the forecast then has to anticipate a change of instrument.
